dedupe_keys.name: load profile data of 50 industrial plants in germany for one year

description: Fritz Braeuer at Karlsruhe Institute of Technology publishes one-year electricity-load profiles for fifty small and medium-sized industrial enterprises in Germany. Temporal coverage is split between two files. One CSV contains twenty plants for 2016 and another contains thirty different plants for 2017. Values are mean power in kilowatts over fifteen-minute intervals. The June 2020 deposit is free under CC BY 4.0 and names studies of industrial electricity-market participation, storage economics and dynamic emission factors. The public metadata do not disclose plant identities, detailed industrial classifications or completeness rates. The two years must not be treated as a panel of the same fifty sites. These measurements can calibrate industrial-demand simulations or compare storage-dispatch strategies. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The observation files were not downloaded, and suitability for a particular industrial subsector remains untested.
